subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Reconhecer prefixos e sufixos produtivos na formação de palavras derivadas de substantivos, de adjetivos e de verbos, utilizando-os para compreender palavras e para formar novas palavras.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer prefixos e sufixos comuns usados para formar palavras derivadas em português
components.description_en: Recognize common prefixes and suffixes used to form derived words in Portuguese
components.cc_component_description: Identify frequently occurring prefixes and suffixes as clues to word meaning

components.description_pt: Aplicar conhecimento de prefixos e sufixos para esclarecer o significado de palavras desconhecidas
components.description_en: Apply knowledge of prefixes and suffixes to clarify the meaning of unfamiliar words
components.cc_component_description: Apply knowledge of prefixes and suffixes to clarify the meaning of unfamiliar words

components.description_pt: Formar novas palavras aplicando prefixos ou sufixos produtivos a nomes, adjetivos ou verbos conhecidos
components.description_en: Form new words by applying productive prefixes or suffixes to known nouns, adjectives, or verbs
components.cc_component_description: Determine the meaning of a new word formed by adding a known affix to a known root word

cc_matches.description: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on grade 2 reading and content, choosing flexibly from an array of strategies.
Use frequently occurring affixes as a clue to the meaning of a word.
Determine the meaning of the new word formed when a known affix is added to a known word (e.g., agreeable/disagreeable, comfortable/uncomfortable, care/careless, heat/preheat).
